name: slice-extract
axis: substring extraction: a W-char sliding window materialised at every offset
notes: A 200_000-char ASCII input; every 12-char window is extracted and hashed, PASSES times (n = windows extracted). Rust's `&s[i..i+W]` is a borrow (no allocation) - that is the structural ceiling, not a measurement flaw. V8 may back a slice with a SlicedString view; VL and CPython copy. Python runs PASSES=6, a 30x reduction.
